title: City Bus
body:
City Bus is a bus built for urban routes, with frequent stops, wide doors, low floors for step-free boarding, and standing room for peak loads. City buses are the backbone of urban public transport, and their routes shape city life.

City buses carry more people than any other urban vehicle, and their reliability is a measure of a city's health.

title: Double-Decker Bus
body:
Double-Decker Bus is a bus with two passenger decks, carrying far more people in the same street footprint. Double-deckers are icons of London, where the Routemaster and its successors became symbols of the city, and they serve busy routes worldwide.

The double-decker is public transport's most recognisable type, and its upper deck is a favourite seat for every visitor.

title: Coach
body:
Coach is a bus built for long-distance travel, with comfortable reclining seats, luggage space, air conditioning, and a toilet on longer models. Coaches carry tourists, school groups, and intercity passengers on routes that trains do not serve.

Coaches are the long-distance bus, and their comfort makes road travel practical over hundreds of miles.

title: School Bus
body:
School Bus is a bus built to carry children to and from school, with high-visibility yellow paint in North America, flashing stop lights, and a stop arm that halts traffic. School buses are among the safest vehicles on the road, by design and by law.

School buses are a childhood institution, and their safety design is a matter of public regulation.

title: Minibus
body:
Minibus is a small bus seating roughly eight to thirty passengers, used for community transport, hotel shuttles, and small-group tours. Minibuses fill the gap between cars and full-sized buses, and they serve routes too small for a big bus.

Minibuses are the flexible face of public transport, and their drivers often know every passenger by name.

title: Articulated Bus
body:
Articulated Bus is a long bus with a flexible joint in the middle, carrying far more passengers than a rigid bus while still turning city corners. Articulated buses serve the busiest urban corridors, where a single vehicle must move a crowd.

Articulated buses are the accordion of the street, bending around corners with a full load aboard.

title: Trolleybus
body:
Trolleybus is a bus powered by electricity from overhead wires through two trolley poles, combining bus flexibility with electric traction. Trolleybuses run quietly and without exhaust, and they serve cities that kept their wire networks.

Trolleybuses are a proven electric bus, older than the battery bus and still running in cities worldwide.

title: Electric Bus
body:
Electric Bus is a bus driven by an electric motor and a battery, charged at depots or at route termini, with no exhaust and quiet operation. Electric buses are rapidly replacing diesel buses in cities, cutting emissions and noise where people live.

Electric buses are the future of city transport, and their adoption is one of the fastest changes in public transport.
